name: roundwise
description: Know what they ask before you walk in — a free interview-prep workspace built on real company-wise question data.

scripts.install:all: npm install && npm install --prefix client && npm install --prefix server
scripts.dev: concurrently -n server,client -c cyan,magenta "npm run dev --prefix server" "npm run dev --prefix client"
scripts.test: npm run test --prefix server && npm run test --prefix client
scripts.lint: npm run lint --prefix client && npm run lint --prefix server
